description: This PHP source file defines the ContactsViewEdit class which extends ViewEdit, providing custom display logic for the 'edit' view of a Contact in SuiteCRM. It contains methods for rendering the view, handling portal-related settings, and injecting JavaScript for client-side validation.

classes.name: ContactsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to customize the edit view for contacts, including portal settings display and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view and sets properties for subpanel and quick create template usage.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to manipulate section panels based on portal settings, populate default values for report fields, and injects JavaScript for client-side validation.
